summary: Reject missing and empty video recording outputs

delivery.outcome: Only report recording success for a nonempty saved video file, preserve accurate executor failure results, and prevent earlier videos from satisfying a later unsaved session. Publish through independent protected review.
nonGoals: No video encoder implementation or browser lifecycle change.
No unrelated daemon, governance or dependency changes.

architecture.decision: Validate the candidate output at VideoRecorder finalization and generate unique expected filenames per session; all existing callers keep the same Optional[str] result.
architecture.rollback: Revert the source commit and preserve generated recordings.

commands: PYTHONPATH=src python -m pytest -q tests/unit/test_media_recorder.py tests/unit/test_executors.py tests/unit/test_novnc_demo.py
